title: Uncovering the Internet’s Hidden Values: An Empirical Study of Desirable Behavior Using Highly-Upvoted Content on Reddit
reasoning: The paper uses LLMs to extract and categorize 'social values' and 'community values' (such as prosociality, empathy, and ethical behavior) from online interactions. It evaluates how well computational models and LLMs can capture these value systems, which directly involves the study and benchmarking of societal values and ethics in an NLP context.
